RLS on; anon/authenticated hold NO privileges; PostgREST answers the anon key with 401/403 (never 200)

a valid pregame record is INSERTED over HTTP; the stored columns match the record and the jsonb equals it semantically (jsonb reorders keys, so compared canonically)

re-recording the same decision is DUPLICATE_IDENTICAL and the stored row is byte-identical (checksum before == after)
25 CONCURRENT writers (25 independent stores over HTTP): exactly one INSERTED, 24 DUPLICATE_IDENTICAL, one row, zero errors
PATCH through PostgREST is REFUSED and the row is unchanged
DELETE through PostgREST is REFUSED and no row disappears
the UPSERT bypass (POST with Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates on an existing id) is REFUSED — an existing observation cannot be replaced via insert
TRUNCATE is not reachable through PostgREST (no such verb); the service role has no TRUNCATE-by-API path
the DATABASE refuses a pregame-composed record that ARRIVES after kickoff (trigger P0001 through PostgREST -> store REFUSED_LATE), even though the app clock still said 'pregame'
the application-side refusal fires first when its own clock is past kickoff (REFUSED_LATE, no HTTP write attempted)
CHECK constraints hold over HTTP: reconstructed-and-eligible (23514), captured_at >= kickoff_at (23514), unknown class (23514), K position (23514)
another model version cannot be stored through the store (REFUSED_INVALID) and cannot overwrite; a foreign-hash row written raw lands as a SEPARATE row and the frozen version's rows stay untouched
